create_mention_ace_reader: create a MentionACEReader instance to read ACE entity mention tags from CoNLL-NER formatted dataset files
read_ace_dataset: read ACE dataset files and yield Instance objects with token and mention tag fields
convert_tokens_to_instance: convert a list of tokens and optional mention tags into an AllenNLP Instance with TextField and SequenceLabelField
iterate_ace_sentences: iterate over ACE sentences from CoNLL files using the ACE dataset reader utility
configure_label_namespace: configure a custom label namespace for ACE mention sequence labeling tasks
